intro: Southwest Dallas County is the focus of this demo.
indexIntro: These guides describe place and process in DeSoto, Cedar Hill, Duncanville, and Lancaster. They are written for this demo and do not replace a live search.

desoto.name: DeSoto
paragraphs: DeSoto is a city in southwest Dallas County, south of Dallas.
Neighboring cities include Cedar Hill, Duncanville, and Lancaster along the same county band.
Streets and parks change character from block to block, so tours stay street-by-street.

cedar-hill.name: Cedar Hill
paragraphs: Cedar Hill is a city in southwest Dallas County.
Rolling terrain and open spaces sit beside older retail corridors and newer subdivisions.
Buyers often compare routes toward Dallas and Fort Worth before picking a daily commute.

duncanville.name: Duncanville
paragraphs: Duncanville is an older inner-ring city in southwest Dallas County.
Main corridors connect to Dallas and to neighboring DeSoto and Cedar Hill.
Blocks mix mid-century homes with infill construction, so walk-throughs stay block-by-block.

lancaster.name: Lancaster
paragraphs: Lancaster is a city in southwest Dallas County, south of Dallas.
The city shares county roads with neighboring DeSoto and Duncanville.
This demo does not include a sample listing card for Lancaster.
